# Pending is a legitimate state

A database with only accepted and rejected values forces people to hide uncertainty in free text. The consent table needed awaiting speaker review; the equipment shelf needed awaiting inspection. These are not missing answers. [[Field methods]] should distinguish an unanswered question from a question nobody is responsible for answering.
